title: 🔄 Returns, Refunds and After-Sales: What Should I Do If Something Goes Wrong?
content:
If you want to cancel an order, return an item, request a refund, or report a problem with your product or parcel, this guide will help you understand what to do.

After-sales problems may happen during different stages, such as before purchase, after purchase, after warehouse arrival, or during international shipping.

The available solution depends on the current order status, the seller’s policy, warehouse processing status, and logistics rules.


🌟 Simple overview

You may need after-sales support if:

  • You placed the wrong order
  • You want to cancel an order
  • The item is out of stock
  • The seller changed the price
  • The wrong item arrived at the warehouse
  • The item is damaged
  • The quantity is incorrect
  • You want to return or exchange an item
  • Your parcel is delayed, damaged, or lost
  • You want to request a refund

Please contact customer service as soon as possible if you notice any issue.

The earlier the problem is reported, the easier it may be to solve.


1. 🕒 If the order has not been paid

If your order is still unpaid, you can usually cancel it directly.

No purchase has been made yet, so there is usually no refund process.

What you should do

  • Go to your order page
  • Cancel the unpaid order
  • Submit a new order if needed


2. 💳 If the order has been paid but not purchased

If you have paid, but we have not purchased the item from the Chinese seller yet, you may request cancellation.

In many cases, the order can be cancelled and refunded.

What you should do

Please contact customer service as soon as possible and provide:

  • Order number
  • Reason for cancellation
  • Whether you want a refund or balance credit

Important note

Once the purchasing process has started, cancellation may not always be possible.


3. 🛒 If the item has already been purchased

If the item has already been purchased from the Chinese seller, cancellation depends on the seller’s policy.

The seller may:

  • Accept cancellation
  • Refuse cancellation
  • Have already shipped the item
  • Require a return after delivery
  • Charge domestic shipping or service-related fees
  • Refuse returns for special products

What you should do

Please contact customer service. We will help check with the Chinese seller.

However, we cannot guarantee that the seller will accept cancellation or return.


4. 🚚 If the seller has already shipped the item

If the Chinese seller has already shipped the item to our warehouse, the order may not be cancellable immediately.

In this case, we may need to wait for the item to arrive at the warehouse before requesting a return.

Possible solutions

  • Wait for warehouse arrival and apply for return
  • Refuse the domestic package if possible
  • Contact the seller for return approval
  • Exchange the item if the seller allows it

Important note

Domestic return shipping fees may apply.


5. 📦 If the item has arrived at the warehouse

After the item arrives at our warehouse, you may request return or exchange if the seller allows it.

Returns or exchanges may depend on:

  • Seller return policy
  • Return time limit
  • Item condition
  • Original packaging
  • Whether the product has been used
  • Whether the product is customized
  • Whether the product is a final-sale item
  • Whether return shipping is required

What you should do

Please submit a return or exchange request as soon as possible.

Provide:

  • Order number
  • Item photos
  • Warehouse photos, if available
  • Clear description of the problem
  • Your preferred solution


6. 🖼️ If the warehouse photo shows a problem

If warehouse photos show an obvious issue, such as wrong color, wrong style, damaged packaging, or missing quantity, please contact customer service before submitting international shipping.

Possible solutions

  • Return the item
  • Exchange the item
  • Ask the seller for compensation
  • Continue shipping after your confirmation
  • Request extra photos for confirmation

Important note

Please check warehouse photos carefully. Once the item is shipped internationally, return or exchange becomes much more difficult.


7. ⚠️ If the wrong item was received

If the warehouse receives an item that does not match your order, please contact customer service.

Examples include:

  • Wrong color
  • Wrong size
  • Wrong model
  • Wrong quantity
  • Wrong product
  • Missing accessories

We may help you check with the seller and request a return, exchange, or other solution.

What you should provide

  • Order number
  • Product link
  • Warehouse photo
  • Screenshot of the ordered option
  • Description of the mismatch


8. 💔 If the item is damaged at the warehouse

If the item appears damaged when it arrives at our warehouse, please contact customer service.

Depending on the situation, we may help you:

  • Contact the seller
  • Request return or exchange
  • Request compensation from the seller
  • Take extra photos
  • Confirm whether you still want to ship the item

Important note

Warehouse photos are usually a basic visual check. They may not detect all hidden defects, functional problems, or size issues.


9. 📏 If the size or quality is not as expected

Size, material, color, and quality may sometimes differ from what you expected.

This may happen because of:

  • Different seller descriptions
  • Manual measurement differences
  • Lighting differences in product photos
  • Different batches
  • User selection error
  • Product quality differences

If you want to return or exchange the item, the result depends on the seller’s policy.

Important note

If the seller does not accept return for personal reasons, return or refund may not be possible.


10. ✈️ If the parcel has already been submitted for international shipping

If you have already submitted the parcel for international shipping, changes may be limited.

If the warehouse has not started packing, it may still be possible to cancel or modify the parcel.

If the parcel is already being packed or has been shipped, cancellation may not be possible.

What you should do

Contact customer service immediately and provide:

  • Parcel number
  • Items involved
  • What you want to change
  • Reason for cancellation or modification


11. 🌍 If the parcel has already been shipped internationally

Once the parcel has been shipped internationally, return, cancellation, or item exchange is usually not possible.

If there is a logistics issue, we may help you check with the logistics provider.

Possible issues include:

  • Long delay
  • Tracking not updating
  • Customs delay
  • Delivery failure
  • Parcel damage
  • Parcel loss

The final solution depends on the shipping method, logistics provider rules, customs situation, and insurance coverage if applicable.


12. 📦 If the parcel is delayed

International shipping may be delayed due to:

  • Customs inspection
  • Flight delay
  • Weather
  • Holidays
  • Peak season
  • Logistics backlog
  • Local courier delay
  • Incomplete recipient information
  • Tax or document requirements

What you should do

Please check the tracking information first.

If the parcel has not updated for a long time, contact customer service and provide:

  • Parcel number
  • Tracking number
  • Destination country
  • Current tracking status
  • How long the tracking has not updated

We will help you check with the logistics provider if needed.


13. 💥 If the parcel is damaged after delivery

If your parcel arrives damaged, please keep all packaging materials and take photos or videos immediately.

Please provide:

  • Parcel number
  • Tracking number
  • Photos of the outer package
  • Photos of the inner packaging
  • Photos of the damaged item
  • Unboxing video, if available
  • Description of the damage

Important note

Please report the issue within the required time. Late claims may not be accepted by logistics providers.


14. ❓ If items are missing after delivery

If you believe an item is missing from your parcel, please contact customer service as soon as possible.

Please provide:

  • Parcel number
  • Order number of the missing item
  • Photos of all received items
  • Photos of the package
  • Package weight shown on the label, if visible
  • Unboxing video, if available

We will help check the warehouse packing record and logistics information.


15. 🧾 Refund methods

Refunds may be returned to:

  • Your account balance
  • Your original payment method
  • Another supported refund method

The available refund method depends on the payment channel and website rules.

Important note

Some fees may not be refundable, such as payment processing fees, used service fees, domestic shipping fees, return shipping fees, or third-party channel fees.


16. ⏳ How long does a refund take?

Refund time may depend on:

  • Order status
  • Seller refund processing time
  • Warehouse processing time
  • Payment provider processing time
  • Bank processing time
  • Currency conversion or cross-border payment rules

Refunds to account balance may be faster than refunds to the original payment method.

If your refund has not arrived after the normal processing time, please contact customer service.


17. 💸 What fees may not be refundable?

Depending on the situation, the following fees may not be fully refundable:

  • Domestic shipping fee already paid to the seller
  • Return shipping fee within China
  • Service fee for completed services
  • Payment processing fee
  • Currency conversion difference
  • Warehouse service fee already used
  • Packaging or reinforcement fee already processed
  • International shipping fee after dispatch
  • Fees charged by logistics providers or customs

The final refundable amount depends on the actual case.


18. 🛡️ Compensation for lost or damaged parcels

If a parcel is lost or damaged during international shipping, compensation depends on the logistics provider’s rules.

The compensation amount may depend on:

  • Shipping method
  • Declared value
  • Insurance, if purchased
  • Product category
  • Proof provided by the user
  • Logistics investigation result
  • Whether the claim is submitted within the required time

Some shipping methods may have limited compensation. Some restricted items may not be covered.

Please check the shipping method’s compensation rules before shipping valuable items.


19. ✅ How to reduce after-sales problems

To reduce problems, we recommend:

  • Check product options carefully before ordering
  • Read the seller’s product description
  • Confirm size, color, model, and quantity
  • Avoid buying restricted or high-risk items
  • Check warehouse photos before shipping
  • Request extra photos if needed
  • Choose reinforcement for fragile items
  • Fill in the correct shipping address
  • Choose a suitable shipping method
  • Keep unboxing videos for valuable parcels

These steps can help reduce mistakes and make after-sales claims easier if something goes wrong.


Important notes

  • Cancellation is easier before the item is purchased.
  • After purchase, return or refund depends on the Chinese seller’s policy.
  • After international shipping, return or exchange is usually very difficult.
  • Please check warehouse photos before submitting international shipping.
  • Domestic return shipping fees may apply.
  • Some service fees and payment fees may not be refundable.
  • Logistics claims require photos, videos, tracking information, and investigation.
  • Compensation depends on the logistics provider’s rules.
  • Please contact customer service as early as possible if there is any problem.


Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: Can I cancel my order after payment?

If the item has not been purchased yet, cancellation may be possible. If the item has already been purchased, we need to check with the Chinese seller.

Q2: Can I return an item after it arrives at the warehouse?

It depends on the seller’s return policy and the item condition. Please contact customer service as soon as possible.

Q3: Can I return an item after it has been shipped internationally?

Usually no. Once the parcel has been shipped internationally, return or exchange is very difficult and may not be supported.

Q4: Who pays the return shipping fee?

Return shipping fees are usually paid by the user unless the seller agrees to cover them. The final result depends on the seller’s policy and the reason for return.

Q5: Can I get a full refund?

It depends on the order status and actual fees already used. Some fees, such as service fees, payment fees, domestic shipping fees, or used warehouse service fees, may not be refundable.

Q6: What should I do if my parcel is damaged?

Take photos and videos immediately. Keep all packaging materials and contact customer service within the required time.

Q7: What should I do if tracking has not updated for a long time?

Please contact customer service with your parcel number and tracking number. We will help check with the logistics provider if needed.

Q8: Is compensation guaranteed for lost or damaged parcels?

No. Compensation depends on the shipping method, logistics provider rules, insurance coverage, proof provided, and investigation result.


Need help?

If you need to cancel an order, request a return, apply for a refund, or report a parcel issue, please contact our customer service team.

To help us assist you faster, please provide:

  • Order number
  • Parcel number, if available
  • Tracking number, if available
  • Product link or screenshot
  • Photos or videos of the issue
  • A clear description of the problem
  • Your preferred solution

We will review the case and help you find the available solution based on the order status, seller policy, warehouse status, and logistics rules.
